title: Token Standard
accepted_erc_definition_note: Same interpretation as ERC-4626 (see ../../GP_ACCEPTED_ERC_DEFINITION.md) -- status: Final in this pinned snapshot's frontmatter qualifies it as EthTrust's 'finalized [ERC]'.
retrieval_method: direct HTTPS GET (curl) of the raw ERCs-repo markdown source, same method as ERC-4626's snapshot.
registered_reason: Second registered standard, deliberately much smaller than ERC-4626, added ONLY to demonstrate that rtf/standards/discovery.py and generator.py are genuinely generic across standard families -- not proof of an exhaustive ERC-20 translation. See ../../../l12_evaluation/RTF_TRIGGER_COVERAGE_REPORT.md (once written) for how the multi-standard fixture uses this.
note_on_terseness: EIP-20's own specification text is notably terser than EIP-4626's -- totalSupply(), balanceOf(), and allowance() carry NO RFC2119 keyword at all in the source text (contrast EIP-4626, where nearly every method has explicit MUST/SHOULD language). clauses.json's own excluded_as_non_normative_note records this explicitly rather than inventing MUST obligations the spec text does not state.
